name: Shouldered Backpack
text: The first time each round you win a trick, if your partner bid nil, they may pass you a card.

signature.trigger: you win your first trick each round, partner on nil

archetypes: Nil Guard; splash Blind Bidder, Nil Champion (as the nil partner)
decision: For you, covering aggressively so your nil partner gets more chances to shed; for your partner, which danger card to hand over after each of your wins.
opponent: Visible pass between tricks; opponents watch the nil hand shrink and the guard's hand grow, and answer by leading low early, before the guard has won anything.
aiNote: As the nil partner, pass the highest card of your shortest non-spade suit, or your highest spade if you hold no side-suit danger.
rationale: A nil partner hands over their most dangerous card once a round, after you've shown you can win tricks, which lifts a nil's success by about a tenth (about +15 to +20 EV with Nil Guard payoffs). Limiting it to your first win keeps it below Sheltering Castle's two-card swap.
deviation: Limited to your first trick each round, since a pass after every win was too strong.
